page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-384 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 720.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 1.88 GB per vCPU, emphasizing dense computational capacity over memory allocation.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-highcpu-384 offers high compute density for workloads that scale horizontally across massive core counts without requiring proportional memory scaling. It is suited for highly parallelized compute-bound workloads, such as large-scale simulations, batch processing, compute-heavy scientific modeling, and highly parallel compilation tasks.
